arguments.command:
bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W, H = 800, 240
stripe_h = 40
bg = (15,15,15)
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), color=bg)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
# Draw a bottom-like stripe at bottom area
stripe_y = H - stripe_h - 20
stripe_color = (40,40,40)
draw.rectangle([0, stripe_y, W, stripe_y+stripe_h], fill=(40,40,40))
draw.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, W, stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(100,100,100), width=2)
# Draw progress (60%)
progress = 0.6
draw.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, int(W*progress), stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(180,180,255), width=3)
# During gesture text overlay
text = "Target 01:23  Dur 03:45  Progr 60%"
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 14)
except:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
draw.text((W//2 - 120, stripe_y+6), text, fill=(255,255,255), font=font)
img.save("/workspace/during_gesture.png")
print("saved during_gesture.png")

# Post-gesture image: same but no overlay text
img2 = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), color=bg)
draw2 = ImageDraw.Draw(img2)
draw2.rectangle([0, stripe_y, W, stripe_y+stripe_h], fill=(40,40,40))
draw2.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, W, stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(100,100,100), width=2)
draw2.line((0, stripe_y+stripe_h-1, int(W*progress), stripe_y+stripe_h-1), fill=(180,180,255), width=3)
# No text overlay
img2.save("/workspace/post_gesture.png")
print("saved post_gesture.png")
PY'
